title: 2020 roadmap on pore materials for energy and environmental applications
claim: High porosity improves pollutant access in aerogel photocatalysts, but monolith formation can reduce photocatalytic activity if light penetration or charge separation is impaired.
explanation: The review distinguishes adsorption, light absorption and carrier transfer, and surface reaction as interacting determinants of activity.
conditions: Optical opacity and an inert supporting framework are identified as possible limitations.
caveats: Good activity of the original powder does not ensure good activity after assembly into an aerogel.
